notes: The tune: "KSA" by Ksa (compiled Sound Tracker at `$CB20`, play `$CB26`: `music/stc/`, variant.json music_extra); the music index matches its AY stream exactly. The menu's init call still goes to `$C000`, zyxboot-11's Whittaker player (`music/`, kind whittaker-storm), whose tune never plays.

Packed: the loader reads 55 sectors to `$61A8`; USR 25000 runs the depacker head (`parts/depack.ann`, the same depacker as zyxtvmbt's music) that unpacks the whole memory `$61A8-$FFFE`. The build makes that memory from the source (the original menu, layout A, with its own font, logo, logo attributes, stars and rhombus, the two music pieces, residue and state) and packs it with tools/lzpack.py (byte-exact, no hints); zeros follow the hook's RET to the end of the 55th sector.

The packed memory is a snapshot of the running menu: the residue entries and the files/state-*.bin (rhombus phases, the catalogue of the author's disk, the screen copy, the IM 2 table) hold what the menu had built when the memory was saved.

packed.head: parts/depack.json
packed.why: the whole memory from $61A8 to $FFFE packed by tools/lzpack.py behind parts/depack.ann; zeros after the hook RET to the 55th sector

music_extra.why: the tune the interrupt plays (CALL $CB26): compiled Sound Tracker, "KSA" by Ksa

residue.why: self-modified operand: the last phase offset index BuildRombPhases wrote
self-modified operand: the last phase index marked
self-modified opcode: the last RES/SET n,(IY) the phase builder used
self-modified opcode: the last BIT n,(HL) SampleStars used
the saved IY and the work bytes after it as the menu left them
the menu's variables (file count, cursor, page) as the saved memory held them
the twinkle position as the saved memory held it
the menu's stack (below MenuStack) as the saved memory held it
BASIC's machine stack under RAMTOP as the saved memory held it

state.why: the rhombus phases BuildRombPhases made from graphics/rhombus.png (RombColumns, RombOffsets, RombWork, PhasesA)
the disk catalogue the menu read (the remix author's disk) when the memory was saved
the clean screen copy (ScreenCopy) the menu kept of its screen
the interrupt JP and the IM 2 vector table the menu set up (Im2Jump, Im2Table)
